hypotheses.E1_current_token_predicts_routes: Held-out current-token lookup predicts at least 45% of FineWeb route labels for every seed.
hypotheses.E2_lexical_routes_transfer_ood: A FineWeb current-token lookup predicts at least 35% of route labels on WikiText and TinyStories for every seed.
hypotheses.E3_routes_are_not_position_lookup: Position-only held-out accuracy is at most 35% for every seed on FineWeb.
hypotheses.E4_structural_shape_has_signal: Current-token structural shape predicts at least 30% of FineWeb route labels for every seed.
hypotheses.E5_semantic_profiles_recur: After permutation alignment, every seed's expert semantic profiles have mean cosine at least 0.80 to seed zero.
hypotheses.E6_route_partitions_recur_pairwise: Every seed pair has adjusted Rand index at least 0.20 on FineWeb.
